name: Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
benefit:
##### ***General Healthcare***

- Healthcare facilities are provided to workers and their dependants through a network of 10 hospitals and 285 dispensaries.
- Financial assistance of ₹300/- is provided for the purchase of spectacles.

##### ***Heart Diseases***
Reimbursement of expenditure up to ₹1,30,000/- is provided for the treatment of heart diseases.
##### ***Kidney Diseases***
Reimbursement
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be a registered beedi worker, cine worker, or an iron, manganese, chrome, limestone, dolomite, or mica mine worker. - The applicant must be a dependant of an eligible worker to claim dependant-specific medical benefits. - The applicant must possess a valid identity card indicating their status as a recognized unorganised worker.
***Post-Selection Conditions / Special Cases*** - _The applicant must be a female worker undergoing her first or second delivery to avail the maternity benefit._ - _The applicant must have exactly two children to avail the family planning operation scheme benefit._
